title: Crop
direction: Print crop marks framing a single point
rationale: The mark at the center of the craft: registration, precision, focus
construction: Two 20-unit L corners on a 120 grid, 28-unit square core

distinctiveness.rationale: Crop marks around a single point are rare as a logo and specific to print/design craft

brand-fit.rationale: Frames the idea of a studio that researches, measures and places a mark precisely

memorability.rationale: Two corners and a square are easy to redraw from memory

versatility.rationale: Holds at 16 px and in one color; corners work as a framing device in layouts

timelessness.rationale: Built from print conventions older than digital design
